alerts.title: TDF renal monitoring may be overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine monitoring for patients on TDF-based regimens. The patient's most recent creatinine (76 umol/L, 2025-12-15) is within normal limits, supporting stable renal function. However, only one creatinine result is documented since ART initiation in 2022, and no repeat creatinine is ordered in today's plan. TDF is nephrotoxic with cumulative risk, so periodic renal monitoring is essential even when the latest value appears acceptable.

evidence.recommended_action: Verify whether serial creatinine monitoring has been performed per guideline schedule. If gaps exist, order serum creatinine and eGFR at this visit.
